title: Score a probability with the log loss
brief: Build a stable softplus and the log loss softplus(z) - y z with a ridge fee, and compare it with the textbook formula where that formula still works.
hints: For softplus, use np.maximum(z, 0) + np.log1p(np.exp(-np.abs(z))). The value inside np.exp is never positive, so it cannot overflow.
The loss of a row is softplus(z) - y * z with z = X @ w. Sum the rows, then add 0.5 * ridge * np.dot(w, w).
At w = 0 every row costs log 2, so the loss is n * log 2 whatever the labels are.
naive_log_loss is the formula from the lesson: -np.sum(y * np.log(p) + (1 - y) * np.log(1 - p)).
